description: Registry of typed workflow node actions implemented by the wf-ui backend (documentation-of-record; consumers arrive in later waves).

actions.summary: Read the markdown content, revision, and title of a markdown node.
Apply a diff operation (append, insert, or replace) to markdown content with an optional revision/lock guard.

params.name: diff
params.description: Diff descriptor: {op: 'append'|'insert'|'replace', text, offset?, length?} — append adds text at end; insert places text at offset; replace swaps length chars at offset with text.

params.name: expectedRevision
params.description: Expected current node revision; mismatch yields markdown_conflict.

params.name: lockId
params.description: Lock id to present when the node is leased (mandatory exclusion while held).

params.name: lockOwner
params.description: Lock holder name to present when the node is leased.

actions.summary: Replace the entire markdown content of a node.

params.name: expectedRevision
params.description: Expected current node revision; mismatch yields markdown_conflict.

params.name: lockId
params.description: Lock id to present when the node is leased.

params.name: lockOwner
params.description: Lock holder name to present when the node is leased.

actions.summary: Append text to the end of a markdown node's content.

params.name: markdown
params.description: Text to append to the current content.

params.name: expectedRevision
params.description: Expected current node revision; mismatch yields markdown_conflict.

params.name: lockId
params.description: Lock id to present when the node is leased.

params.name: lockOwner
params.description: Lock holder name to present when the node is leased.

actions.summary: Find markdown nodes by exact nodeId or case-insensitive title substring; returns metadata only, never content.
Acquire (or renew with an existing lockId) a write lease on a markdown node.

params.name: lockOwner
params.description: Owner name recorded as the lease holder.

params.name: ttlSeconds
params.description: Lease TTL in seconds (default 30, capped at 300).

params.name: lockId
params.description: Existing lock id to renew; omit to create a new lease.

actions.summary: Release a write lease on a markdown node; only the holder may release.

params.name: lockOwner
params.description: Owner name of the lease being released.

params.name: lockId
params.description: Lock id to release (matches holder ownership).

actions.summary: Save full markdown content to a node (alias of markdown.replace without revision guard).
notes: markdown.save delegates to markdown.replace (no lock/revision guard).

actions.summary: Write a full HTML report to a Display node. The user views it fullscreen on the canvas; fully-open JS by user decision (agent-authored content carries the same trust as the agent terminal).

params.name: expectedRevision
params.description: Optional revision guard; write fails on mismatch.

notes: Use {{excalidraw:<nodeId>}} placeholders to embed Excalidraw scenes as inline SVG.

actions.summary: Read the current HTML report of a Display node, plus the built-in usage guide.
Read the full excalidraw scene, revision, and title of an excalidraw node.
Shallow-merge a plain-object patch into the current scene (elements, appState, files, ...).

params.name: patch
params.description: Plain object merged into the stored scene (top-level keys only).

actions.summary: Replace the entire scene; the payload must be an object with elements, appState, and files.
Compute a normalized viewport preview of the scene (bounding box, scale, element count).
Read metadata of the workspace file bound to a file node (path, name, mime, size, exists, stale).
Read a bounded UTF-8 text window of the bound file (preview limits apply).

params.name: offset
params.description: Byte offset to start reading from.

actions.summary: Read file metadata with etag; byte-range content is served by GET /api/workspace/file, not this adapter.
notes: Returns file metadata (path, name, mime, size, etag) only; actual byte-range reads go through the workspace file HTTP route.

actions.summary: Refresh the node-bound file reference against the workspace (size, mtime, etag, exists).
Write UTF-8 text content to the bound file through the workspace op log (full-file writes only).

params.name: offset
params.description: Must be 0 or omitted; partial writes are rejected.

actions.summary: Single-call preview metadata (previewKind, mime, size, textSnippet for text files) for the bound file.
Acquire (or renew with an existing lockId) a write lease on a file node; persisted and TTL-expiring, refused under a foreign lease.

params.name: holder
params.description: Owner name recorded as the lease holder.

params.name: ttlMs
params.description: Lease TTL in milliseconds (default 30000, capped at 300000).

params.name: lockId
params.description: Existing lock id to renew; omit to create a new lease.

actions.summary: Release a write lease on a file node; only the holder may release.

params.name: holder
params.description: Owner name of the lease being released.

params.name: lockId
params.description: Lock id to release (matches holder ownership).

actions.summary: List the sheet names of the bound Excel workbook (.xlsx).
Read one Excel sheet paged: column headers plus the requested page of data rows (never the whole sheet).

params.name: sheet
params.description: Sheet name or 1-based index; defaults to the first sheet.

actions.summary: Read the bound PDF's total page count and document metadata (title, author, subject, ...).
Extract a PDF page range as text with the isEvalSupported:false security baseline.

params.name: pageCount
params.description: Number of pages to extract starting at page (default 1).

actions.summary: List the bound ZIP archive's entries (name, size, compressedSize, directory flag, UTF-8 flag); streamed, never a whole-archive read.
Preview a single text entry of the bound ZIP with a maxBytes bound (truncated flag when capped); binary entries are refused.

params.name: entryName
params.description: Entry name inside the archive (exact, after GBK/UTF-8 decoding).

params.name: maxBytes
params.description: Preview byte cap (default 65536); larger entries are truncated and flagged.

actions.summary: Extract a single ZIP entry into a workspace-controlled destDir; Zip Slip traversal entries are rejected.

params.name: entryName
params.description: Entry name inside the archive; ../ and ..\ segments or absolute paths are rejected (ZIP_SLIP).

params.name: destDir
params.description: Workspace-relative extraction directory (default Harness/a2a/file-extracts/<nodeId>/); escapes outside the workspace are rejected.

actions.summary: Read the latest terminal output window of an agent node's session.
Write terminal input to an agent node's PTY session (server control-plane route; raw or prompt-submit).

params.name: submit
params.description: Prompt-submit mode: char-by-char typing plus a single enter after the prompt marker.

params.name: raw
params.description: Send bytes exactly as given (used by the send-key wrapper).

notes: Server-special-cased in server.mjs: routed to sendRuntimeSessionInput before adapter dispatch.
CLI wrappers: send-input (--session/--text/--raw), send-key (raw keystroke bytes), delegate-agent (typed agent.sendInput via workflow-node-action).

actions.summary: Send a structured 1-to-1 message with envelope fields to one recipient agent node.

params.name: to
params.description: Recipient agent node id or session id.

params.name: replyTo
params.description: Reply to a prior message id.

params.name: contextRefs
params.description: Markdown node references shared with the recipient (referenced by nodeId only).

params.name: raw
params.description: Mark the message raw (no envelope processing).

params.name: force
params.description: Allow delivery without a graph connection to the recipient.

notes: Requires an existing connection between sender and recipient unless force is set (NOT_CONNECTED 403).

actions.summary: Send one structured message with envelope fields to many recipient agent nodes.

params.name: to
params.description: Recipient agent node ids or session ids; defaults to all connected agents.

params.name: contextRefs
params.description: Markdown node references shared with recipients (referenced by nodeId only).

params.name: raw
params.description: Mark the message raw (no envelope processing).

params.name: force
params.description: Allow delivery without graph connections to the recipients.

actions.summary: Read the recorded conversation with a peer agent, aggregated by requestId, or wakeup messages.

params.name: peer
params.description: Peer agent node id or session id (aliases: to, from, target, node).

params.name: requestId
params.description: Aggregate all replies in this request thread across peers.

params.name: wakeup
params.description: Read wakeup-delivery messages instead of the peer conversation.

actions.summary: Read the agent's terminal transcript window from disk.
Start an agent node's PTY session through the server control plane (createRuntimeSession).

params.name: forceRestart
params.description: Restart even if the session is already live.

params.name: initialPrompt
params.description: First task prompt auto-submitted by the runtime TUI.

notes: Server-special-cased in server.mjs: routed to startWorkflowGraphNode (session registry + PTY spawn). The agent adapter export only throws USE_A2A_START.
CLI create-agent is the primary path for creating agent nodes (POST /api/sessions).

actions.summary: Stop an agent node's session and kill its PTY process.
notes: Server-special-cased in server.mjs: routed to stopRuntimeSession. The agent adapter export stops the PTY directly when reached in-process.

actions.summary: Restart an agent node: start a fresh session and stop the previous one.

params.name: initialPrompt
params.description: First task prompt auto-submitted by the runtime TUI.

notes: Server-special-cased in server.mjs: routed to restartWorkflowGraphNode (forceRestart is forced internally). The agent adapter export only throws USE_A2A_START.

actions.summary: Delete an agent node from the workflow graph (must be stopped first).
notes: Rejects deletion of running/starting agents (NODE_LIVE 409); also exported as adapter suffix 'delete' (agent.delete).

actions.summary: Delete an agent node (alias export of deleteAgentNode under the adapter suffix 'delete').
notes: Routed alias of agent.deleteAgentNode (agent-node.mjs exports deleteAgentNode as delete).

actions.summary: Build an agent node's workflow context: identity, connected peers, and available actions.
notes: Special-cased route in workflow-node-runtime executeNodeAction: delegates to getNodeContext (component, agent, event, capability, goal nodes all supported).

actions.summary: Switch an agent node's model by writing the project-scope runtime config file (restart required).

params.name: model
params.description: Model id to write into the project config (max 100 chars).

notes: Server-special-cased in server.mjs: routed to setWorkflowNodeModel; only PROJECT-scope config files are written, and a missing config file is refused (409).
No CLI command yet.

actions.summary: Auto-layout all non-docked workflow graph node positions (tree or grid) as a Main Agent actor.

params.name: actorNodeId
params.description: Actor node id (must be a Main Agent node).

notes: Server-special-cased in server.mjs: routed to executeGraphLayoutAction; requires a Main Agent graph node actor (MAIN_AGENT_REQUIRED 403).

actions.summary: Read a timer node's full state: schedule, heartbeat, loop, whileGuard, taskBinding, controlPolicy, payloadTemplate.
Record a fired event on the timer (backend-internal; scheduler-owned).

params.name: payload
params.description: Event payload; defaults to the timer's payloadTemplate.

notes: Backend-internal action: the HTTP surface denies every actor except the main/controller agent and the internal scheduler marker (F1/F3).

actions.summary: Configure a timer node (title, enabled, schedule, heartbeat); agent actors cannot mutate policy/template/loop/binding fields.

params.name: controlPolicy
params.description: Control policy (main-only; agent configure is denied CONTROL_DENIED 403).

params.name: actorNodeId
params.description: When present, agent policy checks are applied (enable/disable/setInterval/setMode/ackWatchdog).

actions.summary: Enable a timer node (schedule + base heartbeat).
Disable a timer node (subject to control policy).
Set the timer interval seconds (clamped by control policy; lane selects base or watchdog).

params.name: intervalSeconds
params.description: Interval in seconds (clamped to policy min/max).

actions.summary: Set the timer schedule mode (manual|once|interval|cron|loop|adaptive|watchdog|while|task).

params.name: mode
params.description: Schedule mode; invalid values keep the current mode.

actions.summary: Acknowledge the timer watchdog heartbeat (marks state ok with lastAckAt).
Reset the timer watchdog heartbeat (clears missed count and last ping).
Compose the wakeup envelope and append it to the message queue of every agent in the timer's magnetic group (backend-internal).

params.name: intervalSeconds
params.description: Interval reported in the wakeup envelope.

notes: Backend-internal: wakeups land in the message store only (never PTY stdin); agents read them on their next turn. HTTP surface is main/controller or internal-scheduler only.

actions.summary: Advance the timer heartbeat (base due events and watchdog timeouts); scheduler-owned.
notes: Backend-internal action: HTTP surface is main/controller or internal-scheduler only (F1/F3).

actions.summary: Read a github-trigger node's state: repository, eventFilters, payloadTemplate, delivery counters, last event.
Record an inbound GitHub webhook delivery event (runtime action; webhook intake).

params.name: workflowRun
params.description: Workflow run: {id, name, status, conclusion, url} (alias: workflow_run).

params.name: dedupeKey
params.description: Dedupe key; defaults to a composition of event/repo/ref.

actions.example: (webhook) POST to the github-trigger node action route with the delivery payload
notes: Runtime action in the ontology; designed for webhook intake rather than agent-authored calls.

actions.summary: Configure a github-trigger node (title, enabled, repository, eventFilters, payloadTemplate).
Read a skill-group node: description, sourceGroup, skills, skillNames, skillCount, nodeSemantics.
Enable or disable a single skill within a skill-group node.

params.name: enabled
params.description: true to enable, false to disable.

actions.summary: Configure a skill-group node (title, description, sourceGroup, skills).
Read an mcp-connector node: servers, serverNames, transports, envKeyNames, redactedFieldCount.
Configure an mcp-connector node (title, description, sourceGroup, servers, server).
Read a goal node's full state (objective, planItems, acceptance, wdt, confirmation, status).
Patch a goal node's title, objective, nextAction, acceptance, planItems, or wdt fields.

params.name: wdt
params.description: Watchdog timer state: {enabled, state, timerNodeId, lastAckAt}.

actions.summary: Propose goal completion (status proposed-complete) with evidence refs and a note.
Return a proposed-complete goal to active work (status active, confirmation returned).
Append plan items (P-*) and acceptance items (AC-*) to a goal node.

params.name: planItems
params.description: Plan items to append (strings or {text, status}); max 100.

params.name: acceptance
params.description: Acceptance items to append (strings or {text, status}); max 100.

actions.summary: Remove plan items and/or acceptance items by id (implemented as the removeItems helper alias).

params.name: planItemIds
params.description: Plan item ids to remove (e.g. P-001).

params.name: acceptanceIds
params.description: Acceptance item ids to remove (e.g. AC-001).

notes: goal-node.mjs exports removeItems as delete (adapter suffix 'delete'); unknown ids are returned in skipped.

actions.summary: Replace the entire planItems and/or acceptance lists of a goal node.

params.name: planItems
params.description: Full replacement plan items (strings or {id, text, status}); max 100.

params.name: acceptance
params.description: Full replacement acceptance items (strings or {id, text, status}); max 100.

actions.summary: Mark plan items done by id (status done, records updatedBy/updatedAt).

params.name: planItemIds
params.description: Plan item ids to check (e.g. P-001).

actions.summary: Mark plan items back to todo by id (records updatedBy/updatedAt).

params.name: planItemIds
params.description: Plan item ids to uncheck (e.g. P-001).

actions.summary: Propose goal completion once all plan items are done (rejects with goal_items_pending otherwise).
Reopen a completed goal back to active status with confirmation state returned.
Acknowledge the goal watchdog timer (wdt state ok with lastAckAt and timerNodeId).

params.name: timerNodeId
params.description: Timer node id recorded in the wdt state.

actions.summary: Delete any workflow node (component, event, capability, goal) by id; live agent nodes must be stopped first.
notes: Server-special-cased in workflow-node-runtime executeNodeAction: routed to deleteNode before adapter dispatch. Agent graph nodes use agent.deleteNode/agent.deleteNodes (graph category).

actions.summary: Restore a previously deleted workflow node from its snapshot (state recovery + graph restore).

params.name: recovery
params.description: Recovery payload: {graphId, node: {type, nodeId, componentState|eventState|capabilityState}} or the snapshot fields flattened.

params.name: graphId
params.description: Graph node id to restore (top-level alias).

notes: Server-special-cased in workflow-node-runtime executeNodeAction: routed to restoreNode (restoreComponentNode/restoreEventNode/restoreCapabilityNode by node kind).

actions.summary: Create a workflow graph node (component, event, capability, or goal) as a Main Agent actor.

params.name: type
params.description: Node type: markdown, excalidraw, file, timer, github-trigger (needs experimental: true), skill-group, mcp-connector, goal.

params.name: node
params.description: Nested node payload: {type, title, position, ...type-specific fields}.

params.name: mcpServerId
params.description: MCP server id to attach for mcp-connector nodes.

params.name: experimental
params.description: Required true for github-trigger creation (PLANNED_NODE_REQUIRES_EXPERIMENTAL otherwise).

notes: Server-special-cased: routed to executeAgentGraphAction (Main Agent actors only, assertMainAgentGraphActor). To create agent nodes (PTY sessions) use the create-agent CLI / agent.start instead.

actions.summary: Connect two workflow nodes with a typed edge (Single-Goal rule enforced) as a Main Agent actor.

params.name: to
params.description: Target node or session (aliases: target, targetNodeId).

params.name: from
params.description: Source node or session (aliases: source, sourceNodeId; default: actor).

params.name: relation
params.description: Edge relation (default: delegation; e.g. context, event, control, goal, capability, wf-bridge).

notes: Server-special-cased: routed to executeAgentGraphAction (Main Agent actors only); also reachable via node-map --action connectNodes.

actions.summary: Remove an edge between two workflow nodes by edge id as a Main Agent actor.
notes: Server-special-cased: routed to executeAgentGraphAction (Main Agent actors only).

actions.summary: Move a workflow node to a new graph position as a Main Agent actor.

params.name: position
params.description: New position: {x, y} (or pass x/y directly in the payload).

notes: Server-special-cased: routed to executeAgentGraphAction (Main Agent actors only).

actions.summary: Delete a single workflow graph node as a Main Agent actor (live agent nodes require allowLiveAgentDelete/force).
notes: Server-special-cased: routed to executeAgentGraphAction (Main Agent actors only); also reachable via node-map --action deleteNode.

actions.summary: Delete multiple workflow graph nodes (or all non-actor nodes) as a Main Agent actor.
notes: Server-special-cased: routed to executeAgentGraphAction (Main Agent actors only).

actions.summary: Read the full workflow graph snapshot (nodes, edges, positions, capsule dock links) as a Main Agent actor.
notes: Server-special-cased: routed to executeAgentGraphAction (Main Agent actors only).

actions.summary: Undo the most recent graph operation (moveNode/connectNodes/disconnectNodes/updateEdge/attachDock/detachDock/setDockSide/layout/deleteNode/createNode) by replaying its inverse slice; human and agent edits share one server-owned history.

params.name: scope
params.description: Scope selector; 'graph' (default) applies the workflow graph history.

params.name: expectedVersion
params.description: Optional graph version guard; mismatch yields STALE_GRAPH_VERSION (409).

notes: Server-special-cased in server.mjs: routed to undoGraphOp; requires an Agent graph node actor; empty stack is idempotent ({ok:true, applied:null}).

actions.summary: Redo the most recently undone graph operation by replaying its forward slice.

params.name: scope
params.description: Scope selector; 'graph' (default) applies the workflow graph history.

params.name: expectedVersion
params.description: Optional graph version guard; mismatch yields STALE_GRAPH_VERSION (409).

notes: Server-special-cased in server.mjs: routed to redoGraphOp; requires an Agent graph node actor; empty stack is idempotent ({ok:true, applied:null}).
